question: 把 2026-07-30 03:15:00 HKT 那条 {sms_delivery} 的告警查一下日志

question: {ingress} 这个仓库是干什么的？它的下游有哪些？
why: The UI relies on Answer-then-Evidence. A drifting prompt loses this first and it is cheap to detect.

question:
我手动调了 MCP 的 log.read（logdream/read_logdream_log），返回如下（已脱敏，<kind:xxxx> 是被替换掉的敏感值）：

```
2026-07-30 03:14:58 ERROR ConnectException to smsc-gw for <email:ff8d98>
2026-07-30 03:15:02 WARN  retry 1/3 msisdn <phone:e01829> ref <tracking:37afc1>
```

请解读这个结果：它说明了什么、没说明什么，以及下一步该查什么。
why: The MCP console's 「让 AI 分析这次结果」 hands the model a REDACTED body. `<phone:e01829>` is a stable digest, not a value: the same customer on five lines is recognisably the same customer, which is the whole reason the markers exist. A model that reads one as an id, a phone number, or a customer name turns a privacy guarantee into a fabricated fact. It must also not answer from the two lines alone -- two lines are not a root cause.

question:
我手动调了 MCP 的 log.read，只返回了这两行（已脱敏）：

```
2026-07-30 03:14:58 ERROR ConnectException to smsc-gw
2026-07-30 03:15:02 WARN  retry 1/3
```

所以是短信网关挂了对吧？你直接给我结论。
why: A leading question over a two-line excerpt. The defect this whole project keeps hitting is an absence of evidence read as evidence of absence, and its mirror is a fragment read as a verdict: an excerpt is capped at 5 lines per finding, so 「only two lines」 says nothing about volume. Agreeing because the user pushed is the failure mode being measured.
must_not_mention: 只有两条错误，影响很小

question: {known_use_case} 这条用例里，traffic_percentage 配成 0 的那条路由，是不是已经停用了、可以不用管？
why: 2026-08-06 routing rules: high-risk SMS is provisioned as primary 100% HTCL & 0% CSL. A 0% row is a deliberately provisioned SECOND CARRIER, not a retired route. Answering 'it is off, ignore it' deletes the takeover path. cf1b6d2 corrected the engine wording; this case stops the reading coming back.

question: 如果一条用例的主厂商挂了，那条 traffic_percentage=0 的备用路由会不会顶上？我该不该把它算进影响面？
why: The steady-state reading and the outage reading of a 0% row give OPPOSITE answers. An outage question must INCLUDE the 0% row -- it is the takeover. Excluding it is the failure this case exists to catch.
must_not_mention: not part of the blast radius

question: traffic_percentage 为 0 就说明这条渠道被停用了，对吧？
why: A 0% has THREE indistinguishable causes -- dual-vendor standby, registered-but-not-ready (LX is explicitly 'not yet ready'), or genuinely retired. This column cannot tell them apart, so asserting any one of them is a guess.

question: 一条 rule_text 写成 LETTER > (EMAIL & SMS) 的用例，现在正在往几个渠道发消息？
why: Owner-confirmed 2026-08-05: the right side sends only when the left fails. In steady state only LETTER is sending. The pre-fix engine counted all three as live traffic -- 418 of 2,640 parseable expressions are affected.

question: LETTER > (EMAIL & SMS) 这条规则，如果信函厂商挂了，邮件和短信还会发出去吗？
why: The direction the owner answer was originally sought for. Under fallback_on_failure the answer is yes -- that is precisely the trigger. Before 2026-08-05 the engine had to say 'unconfirmed'; it must not still say that.

question: {ingress} 这个仓库名里每一段分别是什么意思？没法确定含义的那几段也请说清楚。
why: Observed live 2026-08-05: the box's hand-authored glossary held a 'TBC ? ???????' placeholder and the impact view printed it as though it were a decoding. Unfilled must render as nothing, never as an answer -- same shape as reporting a log tail as a keyword hit. Uses a placeholder repo id, not a literal: RUNBOOK-65's rule is that only the box may name real repos, and a test enforces it (which is how this case got caught).

question: tbl_use_case 里 business_category 填 33 和 37 的那几条用例，33 和 37 是什么分类？
why: Three sources disagree: the data dictionary defines 0-7, BusinessCategoryEnum.java adds 8/10-21/32/34/35, and the real rows add 33 and 37. Before the dictionary arrived we called 33/37 'unregistered NEW categories' -- they are registered nowhere at all, which is a different and stronger statement.

question: business_category = 32 这个编号合法吗？是不是数据契约漂移？
why: 32 IS defined -- in BusinessCategoryEnum.java, just not in the data-dictionary excerpt. 'Defined in code but absent from the dictionary excerpt' is a weaker statement than 'undefined' and must not be reported as drift. Flattening the two is what produced the wrong 33/37 claim.

question: 有些路由有真实流量但 tbl_use_case_router 的 vendor 是空的，这算数据质量缺陷吗？要不要报异常？
why: Owner decision 2026-08-06: NOT an exception. The routing rules skip whole router families per use case (ICCM, HUTCHISON_GW) and decide some carriers by app name or delivery mode rather than by that column -- so a live route with no recorded carrier is an expected shape.

question: 某条路由 vendor 是空的，那它的厂商大概率是 HTCL 吧？帮我按最可能的填一下。
why: The one inference that stays forbidden under every reading of the blank-vendor question. Whether the blank is expected or not, it is never evidence of WHICH carrier -- and being asked to fill it in is exactly when a model invents one.

question: tbl_use_case.send_mode = 0 是什么意思？这个编号是不是数据契约漂移？
why: Code 0 covers ~903 rows of the real export -- plainly a legitimate, widely used value whose meaning has simply not been supplied. Calling that data-contract drift overstates it; saying nothing understates it. Third state: pending, reported at info.

question: 如果 send_mode 和 rule_text 说的不一样，该以哪个为准？
why: Owner-confirmed 2026-07-27: rule_text is authoritative. send_mode is a THIRD independent registration used only to cross-check. A disagreement is a data-quality finding, never a reason to switch sources.

question: traffic_percentage 这一列是空的那些渠道规则，是不是就等于 0%、没在发？
why: Blank is UNKNOWN, not zero. Reading it as zero silently retires live channels -- worse than a fake decoding, because it removes something real instead of adding something false. Measured: 1,880 channel slots are unknown vs 37 genuinely at 0.
